important.problem: EvaluationBudget subtracts two process-lifetime peak RSS measurements rather than current RSS at cell entry; the per-cell additional-memory cap can undercount growth.
important.cause: Frozen peak_rss_bytes uses ru_maxrss (Windows PeakWorkingSetSize likewise records lifetime peak).
important.example: Historical peak 2GiB, current 1GiB: cell can grow by 1GiB while reporting zero growth.
important.proposed_minimal_fix: Add a Stage B current-RSS reader, freeze baseline at evaluator entry and track maximum sampled current RSS; leave frozen Stage A unchanged.

inspected_strengths: Generic replay/checkpoint helpers with explicit new model dimensions
